items.title: How Much Does a 61-Year-Old Federal Retiree Need in the TSP to Collect $8,000 a Month With a Pension?
items.summary: A $70,000 pension covers most of the budget, so the TSP only has to fill a smaller gap. But pick the wrong withdrawal rate and inflation, taxes, and a COLA freeze until 62 can quietly widen that gap year after year.

items.title: Citi Expects Data Center Construction Growth to Continue Despite Rising Costs and Regulatory Delays
items.summary: Citi expects the expansion of data center infrastructure to continue despite rising construction expenses, additional regulatory requirements and higher financing costs following the US midterm elections, citing sustained demand for artificial intelligence computing capacity. In a research note published Wednesday, Citi strategist Steph Choe said additional permits, regulatory reviews and restrictions could extend development timelines and increase costs for companies building and operating data

items.title: How long can fiscal policy stay accommodative amid higher yields?
